title: Immaculate GP Practice
content: Doctor asked me to book appointment for blood test after seeing her, reception first checked next available appointment in about 2 weeks, after explained appointment was urgent, on the spot receptionist spoke to the nurse and nurse conducted my blood test immediately, I have never before in my life seen such fast and excellent service experience, I was so please and proud to be a patient at the GP practice, thank you to the reception team and the nurse team you are wonderful team.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
